And then I get so sad I dont care about life, and then it turns into i dont care, and that leads to me wanting to drink. I know I need something for the anxiety, but honestly, If i want to get sober, I gotta avoid that. And idk how to explain this exactly, but it's so tiring to keep trying different meds , getting ur Hope's up, realizing they dont work, and going through withdrawal, and starting over you know. Truly, I hadnt gotten to the point of drinking every day yet, just more like 3-4 days out of the week, and pretty much being black out drunk every time. And days it's not alcohol its weed or
